items.text: Bears TE Cole Kmet ruled out with knee injury after being carted off TNF.
items.implication: Loveland expanded role as primary TE.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua left practice early Thursday due to a calf injury and was listed as limited.
items.why: Calf injury during Thursday practice; Adams already on IR.
items.implication: Status for Week 7 vs Raiders in doubt; Friday report key.
items.opportunity: If out, targets to Higbee/Parkinson/Mumpfield/Whittington; if in, massive volume post-Adams.

items.text: Saquon Barkley is back/in line to play Week 7 vs Dallas; efficient in two full games this season. Dallas strong fantasy matchup for RBs. Berry ranks RB15.
Chiefs WR Rashee Rice officially didn’t practice for a second straight day due to his hamstring injury.
items.implication: Elevated risk of missing or limited vs Seahawks; monitor Friday.

items.text: Seahawks activated RB Zach Charbonnet from PUP list, a significant move. Full participant recently.
items.why: Return from knee/ACL; full practice step.
items.implication: Committee with Walker vs KC; TD-dependent flex.

items.text: Josh Jacobs was allowed in team meetings, lifting, medical treatments and non-football activities at the facility. MarShawn Lloyd (49th EPA/rush) and Kaleb Johnson (53rd) have been quite bad amid OL issues.
items.why: Facility access positive signal; backups poor EPA.
items.implication: Long-term outlook discussed on ROS Top-150; closer to return boosts value.
items.opportunity: Jacobs RB1 role when back; handcuffs limited.

items.text: Yards per target to Justin Jefferson: Mullens 10.8, Cousins 10.5, Darnold 10.0, Wentz 9.9, JJ McCarthy 5.7. Tough to ignore despite scheme/coach differences and small sample as Giants plan to start McCarthy.
items.why: McCarthy YPT data poor vs prior QBs.
items.implication: Jefferson efficiency concern with new starter vs Houston.

items.text: Terrance Ferguson not expected ready off IR soon; biggest Adams beneficiary delayed. Rams' only answer now is 25 Puka Nacua targets per game.
items.why: Ferguson recovery delayed per Schefter; Adams out 6-10 weeks.
items.implication: Massive target share for Nacua when healthy.
items.opportunity: Elite WR1 volume ROS if available.

items.text: Berry LOVES A.J. Brown @ CHI (WR10). Bears good for yardage; Brown back in real role with high route/target share.
items.why: Matchup + usage (33% target share, 97% routes recently).

items.text: Berry LOVES DeVonta Smith vs DAL (WR11). Elite volume; Lions/Bears themes but Smith seeing high share.
Berry HATES Josh Jacobs @ DET (RB18). Workload question after long layoff.
items.conflict: Levitan more positive on facility access/backups.

items.text: Berry LOVES Bucky Irving @ CAR (RB12). Big workload in friendly matchup; defenses carved by RBs.
Berry LOVES Chuba Hubbard vs TB (RB10). Consistent big workload in favorable spot.
Thorman Snaps & Pace: Up in pace TB@CAR; high volume GB/DET, LAR/LV. Slow slogs MIA@NYJ. Other slate notes.
items.implication: Favor high-pace games for volume plays.
items.opportunity: More snaps/plays in TB/CAR, Pack/Lions, Rams/Raiders.
